ranked.headline: Deep models of gene expression are tested for context-dependent generalisation
ranked.summary: Predictive architectures for expression and omics are now paired with explicit tests of generalisation, robustness, and uncertainty across datasets and…

ranked.headline: Probing what genomic language models encode and where their predictions fail
ranked.summary: Causal validation and fine-tuned functional prediction now test what DNA language models actually encode and where they fall short.

ranked.headline: Pangenome resources and graph-based methods reshape human genome variation analysis
ranked.summary: HPRC Release 2 and VN1K extend pangenome coverage to population scale, while new phasing methods exploit graph-based variation representations.

ranked.headline: Biological priors fused with latent models for interpretable single-cell inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair mechanistic priors with learned single-cell models and test their reliability under distribution shift.

ranked.headline: Open pipelines link microbial genome content and regulation to AMR and bioactivity
ranked.summary: Standardized, reproducible workflows now automate AMR profiling, BGC novelty, and cross-strain regulatory comparisons across bacterial genomes and RNA-seq.

ranked.headline: Contiguous plant genomes tie transposons and structural variants to trait evolution
ranked.summary: Recent chromosome-scale and telomere-to-telomere assemblies now pair contiguous genomes with population-level variant and trait analyses.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved chromosome-scale genomes of pomegranate and tetraploid wheat
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome assemblies now link polyploid crop genome structure to domestication traits and GWAS loci.

ranked.headline: Auditing and external evaluation of single-cell and genomic foundation models
ranked.summary: Pre-registered and provenance audits now test whether single-cell and DNA foundation models deliver beyond strong baselines and clean data.

ranked.headline: Neural decoders tested on naturalistic video, narrative, and real-time perception
ranked.summary: Human neural decoders are moving from constrained paradigms toward naturalistic stimuli, continuous recordings, and real-time evaluation.

ranked.headline: Protein language models extended to PTM syntax, PPI interfaces, and phase separation
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings are being repurposed beyond single-chain property prediction toward PTMs, interaction interfaces, and condensate behavior.

ranked.headline: Learned representations of cortical folding and multilevel human brain atlas tools
ranked.summary: Self-supervised cortical folding representations are now tested by multivariate GWAS in 35,940 UK Biobank participants.

ranked.headline: Computational models infer gene regulation and cell interactions from omics readouts
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial and cfDNA datasets now enable inference of regulatory and interaction structure at finer resolution than gene-level averages.

ranked.headline: EEG decoding benchmarks test text feasibility, subject heterogeneity, frozen encoders
ranked.summary: Standardized EEG benchmarks now expose subject-level heterogeneity and show that portfolio-based reduction can shrink the decoder search space.

ranked.headline: Biological priors built into graph and neural models for disease prioritization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed knowledge graphs and biological structure into neural models to make disease predictions and candidate annotations interpretable.

ranked.headline: Bayesian models address latent structure, missingness, and uncertainty in biomedical data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method extend Bayesian inference to causal discovery, missing phenotypes, and disease progression modeling.

ranked.headline: Phylogeny-aware placement and foundation models advance microbiome sequence inference
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale phylogenies and pretrained microbiome models now enable near-haplotype resolution and multimodal outcome prediction from sequence data.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multiomics links chromatin states to gene expression across tissues
ranked.summary: Joint profiling of chromatin, methylation and 3D architecture in single cells now reaches human retina, Alzheimer's brain and aging vasculature.

ranked.headline: Annotation-free profiling reveals context-dependent RNA species and processing
ranked.summary: Annotation-free and small-RNA methods now resolve circRNA forms and parental RNA fragmentation that vary by tissue or condition.

ranked.headline: Selective resolution levels in transcriptomic and connectomic biological inference
ranked.summary: Choosing high-coverage cells, improved genomes, and direct circuit paths sharpens which units of measurement support biological inference.

ranked.headline: Contaminated rRNA reference databases misassign metatranscriptomic reads
ranked.summary: Widely used SSU rRNA references carry LSU contamination that misassigns reads, and new curated genome resources are appearing alongside cleaned database…

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts RNA structure, IRES activity, and codon design from sequence
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications extend sequence-only deep learning to RNA 3D structure, IRES prediction, and multi-objective codon optimization.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines quantify multidimensional biological measurements across scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a peer-reviewed cardiac study apply tensor, spatial, and time-series methods to quantify complex biological data.

ranked.headline: Browser and containerized platforms deliver RNA-seq, microarray and gene-list analysis
ranked.summary: Established transcriptomic and gene-set methods are now packaged as web, Docker and desktop tools for routine use.

ranked.headline: Computational models probe allosteric sites, protein switches and antibody neutralization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend structure-based prediction and design beyond static poses to allosteric sites, conformational switches, and kinetic MD data.

ranked.headline: Structural and evolutionary features score protein interactions and variant impact
ranked.summary: Interaction-level and variant-level scoring now draw directly on structural, evolutionary, and physicochemical features across three recent studies.

ranked.headline: Reproducible workflows for barcode and microbial function inference from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Four recent preprints package long-read and metabarcoding analysis as containerized, reproducible tools running from raw reads to annotations or barcodes.

ranked.headline: Repeat-rich sex chromosomes and centromeres resolved in complete genome assemblies
ranked.summary: Complete telomere-to-telomere and long-read assemblies now enable direct mapping of repetitive sex-chromosome and centromeric sequence across lineages.

ranked.headline: Resolving typing and resistance inference limits in bacterial and mycobacterial sequencing
ranked.summary: Comprehensive rapid diagnostics for drug-resistant tuberculosis remain absent, motivating culture-free sequencing evaluations for genotyping and resistance…

ranked.headline: Ensemble learning and multi-environment GWAS advance crop trait prediction and mapping
ranked.summary: Post-GWAS interpretation and genomic prediction for complex crop traits are being advanced by new ensemble, multi-environment, and fine-mapping tools.

ranked.headline: Segmentation models now quantify live-cell, multiplexed, and whole-organism imaging data
ranked.summary: General segmentation and detection models are now validated against experimental readouts in imaging-based biology.

ranked.headline: Cross-feeding and degree-dependent interactions shape community feasibility and stability
ranked.summary: Two 2026 preprints and a published eco-evolutionary study address feasibility, stability, and robustness of community models.

ranked.headline: Models resolve membrane interface features, EBV protein analogs and IRE1 peptide binding
ranked.summary: Structure predictors and atomistic simulations now address membrane interfaces, viral membrane protein analogs and IRE1 peptide binding.

ranked.headline: Genome redundancy and model constraints shape reachable evolutionary innovations
ranked.summary: Simulation and model studies from July 2026 link ploidy, plasticity, and pathway structure to which evolutionary outcomes are accessible.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and constrained models probe partially observed biological dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend model-based analysis to partially observed, constraint-based, and interface-layered biological systems.

ranked.headline: Data-anchored mechanistic models constrain epidemic, epigenetic, and vaccine dynamics
ranked.summary: Two preprints and one published study apply state-dependent mechanistic models to epidemic, epigenetic, and vaccine uptake data.

ranked.headline: Reference-guided synteny and gene family tools expand genome comparison workflows
ranked.summary: Three new preprints automate synteny, transposon annotation and plant gene family analysis, extending genome comparison toward automated workflows.

ranked.headline: Embedding provenance and validation into omics software infrastructure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package provenance, validation, and lineage tracking directly into omics software layers for deployment.

ranked.headline: Noise propagation and feedback topology shape stochastic gene expression persistence
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend rare-event, linear noise, and noise-driven robustness analyses to post-transcriptional and feedback-regulated gene expression.

ranked.headline: Flanking chromatin context and mesoscale architecture shape transcription factor binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify chromatin and nucleosome context as determinants of TF-bound enhancer activity beyond motif content alone.
